verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents a developer API platform covering cards, payments, transactions and expense data, including a POST /v1/cards/transactions query endpoint, so financial data can be read programmatically. Its accounting integration is described only as a one-click sync with NetSuite, QuickBooks and Xero, not as an API surface. Missing for 10: a dedicated accounting API (GL codes, categories, accounting sync or export endpoints), documented write or manage operations on accounting records, a publicly reachable API spec (OpenAPI probes returned 404), and independent corroboration.
